title: Nearly 19.6 million eligible to vote in Taiwan's local elections

title: MOFA to court new U.S. lawmakers after midterms gut pro-Taiwan caucuses
summary: Taipei, Nov. 24 (CNA) The Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said Tuesday it would seek support from newly elected U.S. lawmakers after 12 of the Senate Taiwan Caucus's 38 members and 63 of the Congressional Taiwan Caucus's 220 members lost their seats in this month's midterms.

title: U.S. policy on Taiwan unchanged despite Xinhua's Trump claim: MOFA
summary: Taipei, Nov. 24 (CNA) The United States has reaffirmed to Taiwan that its policy toward the country remains unchanged, a senior Taiwanese diplomat said Tuesday, following a Chinese state media report quoting U.S. President Donald Trump as saying that Washington "does not support Taiwan independence."
